summary: Load-time native-binary dropper fetching from Cloudflare Workers hosts with DNS TXT fallback
details: On require() of the package's main entry, _compat.js downloads a platform-specific native binary from hardcoded Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev) with a DNS TXT fallback under *.dl.well1.site, writes it to /tmp or %TEMP% under a cover-story name (e.g. dotnet_diag_*,.cache_*), chmods it 0755, and detached-spawns it via cp.spawn("/bin/sh", ["-c", fp + " &"], {detached:true, stdio:"ignore"}). Host strings are split and concatenated at runtime (e.g. ["oob-worker.cf101-adf.w","orkers.dev"].join("")) to evade static analysis, and execution is gated by a TTL marker file plus opt-out env vars framed as telemetry. A ~81KB lib/telemetry.js styled as an APM/analytics SDK is bundled but never required from index.js or _compat.js; it replicates the same dropper primitives (spawn /bin/sh, chmodSync 0755, base64 chunk assembly) and reinforces the analytics/telemetry cover story. The package name and shipped code do not correspond to any documented library function beyond the dropper path.
